rawFindings.title: Incorrect base directory extraction for glob patterns with special characters
rawFindings.explanation: The new implementation replaces the original single regex with multiple replacements that separately remove parts containing '*', '!(...)' or '+(...)' and '(...)?'. However, these sequential replacements may incorrectly trim the base directory when combined or applied in certain pattern structures. They also may inconsistently handle paths containing parentheses that are part of directory names rather than glob patterns, potentially resulting in incorrect base directory paths being returned. Thi
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert to the original regex that correctly removes any part of the pattern starting with a slash followed by any characters up to any special globbing character including '*', '(' etc. or improve the regex to correctly handle all required glob pattern cases in a single expression, preserving directory names with parentheses. Consider adding unit tests for edge cases with parentheses in directory names to validate correctness.
